18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Tol palette and monospace count labels show design intent, but the collapsed-node count badges reuse the Phylum pink (#EE6677), colliding with the rank color legend, and the tree occupies only the top half of the viewport leaving conspicuous dead space below.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout uses appropriate categorical color encoding for rank levels with no quantitative deception — no baseline violations, no radius scaling issues, and layout dimensions are data-driven; minor robustness concern is the composite name+depth key instead of stable unique IDs, which could corrupt transitions if duplicate names appear at the same depth.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() calls before starting new 500ms transitions means rapid clicking or typing during animation can cause conflicting mid-flight transitions; search is properly debounced, pointer events API avoids mouse-touch fight, and no brush/zoom update storms or cross-view dispatch loops exist.
18-collapsible-tree-search.cognitive_load_note: Single-view collapsible tree with progressive disclosure keeps working memory low at any expansion state; 6-color rank legend is well within perceptual limits, collapsed-node counts (+N) communicate hidden depth without exposing it, and search narrows focus further — the main risk is label crowding when fully expanded (~200 nodes), but the default collapsed state and interaction design manage this effectively.
